why_agent_cannot: log in or create the account (human session)
what_human_must_do: Log in / create the account in the shared profile, then the agent can continue.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the terminal Go to interstate.trade . The homepage says you can trade Solana, Base, BNB, Ethereum, Monad and Robinhood from a single account.
2 Step 2 : Read the token lists Scroll the trending tokens, top gainers and top memecoins sections on the homepage. The Discover page holds the full list.
3 Step 3 : Open the trenches Press the "Open the trenches" button, or go straight to the Pulse page , to see the live token view the site offers.
4 Step 4 : Open a token's trade page Every row on the homepage has a Buy button that leads to that token's trade page, for example Anakin Coin .
